prompt: Tosylation + SN2: 1-butanol + TsCl / pyridine (makes a tosylate); then NaCN in DMSO. Draw the final product.

answers.label: pentanenitrile (chain extended by 1 C via tosylate SN2)

explanation: OH is a terrible leaving group — but OTs is excellent (tosylate anion is super-stable). Convert OH → OTs with TsCl/pyridine (no rearrangement!), then any good Nu does SN2. Here CN⁻ gives a nitrile — a classic chain-extension sequence.
